home.headline: See your walls in a new color before you paint
home.sub: Try our colors on a photo of your own room, then send us your request on WhatsApp for a free quote.
home.step1: Tell us what you want painted
home.step2: Pick colors and preview them on your wall
home.step3: Send the request to us on WhatsApp

pwa.offline: You're offline. Sending a request needs an internet connection.

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Open it from your home screen like any other app. Faster, and works offline.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosStep3: Tap “Add”, then open the app from your Home Screen.
install.iosNote: Use Safari. On iPad, the Share button is at the top of the screen.
